_comment: Human/tooling-facing listing of what's in Hom/plugins/ -- also now what 'hom search'/'hom show' read (see tools/hom/hom.cpp's FetchIndex()/ParsePluginIndex()). Keep 'version' here in sync with each plugin's own plugin.json -- hom compares this field against a plugin's locally-extracted plugin.json to decide 'hom list --upgradable', so a stale version here will just make hom think there's nothing to upgrade.

plugins.name: input-overlay
plugins.description: Keyboard / mouse / gamepad input overlay presets (WASD, QWERTY, mouse, gamepad).
plugins.author: HomRec

plugins.name: bter
plugins.description: Grab-bag utility plugin (27 console commands - see commands.md section 19) - harmless, no real dependencies, mainly here as something real for `hom install bter` to fetch when testing the package manager itself.
plugins.author: HomRec

plugins.name: watermark
plugins.description: Registers watermark_path/watermark_opacity settings and a "watermark" command to quickly reuse your logo overlay across recordings.
plugins.author: homaaio

plugins.name: rec-info
plugins.description: "recinfo" console command - prints the current recording configuration (resolution, fps, codec, quality, mic, output folder) in one place.
plugins.author: homaaio

plugins.name: webhook-notify
plugins.description: Posts a Discord/Slack incoming-webhook message when recording starts, stops, or an Instant Replay is saved.
plugins.author: homaaio

plugins.name: soundboard
plugins.description: "play <name>" / "soundlist" console commands - plays .wav clips from the plugin's assets folder through your system audio.
plugins.author: homaaio

plugins.name: clip-organizer
plugins.description: Automatically files each Instant Replay save into a dated Clips\YYYY-MM-DD\ subfolder of your output folder.
plugins.author: homaaio

plugins.name: now-playing
plugins.description: "nowplaying" console command - reads the current track from a local now-playing text file (Spotify/foobar2000/etc export) and shows it as a toast.
plugins.author: homaaio

plugins.name: profiles
plugins.description: "profile save|load|list <name>" - named snapshots of resolution/fps/codec/quality/mic settings, one command away (or bind a custom hotkey to a "profile load ..." line).
plugins.author: homaaio

plugins.name: diag-tools
plugins.description: gpuinfo / cpuload / diskfree / activewindow console commands for troubleshooting capture/performance issues.
plugins.author: homaaio

plugins.name: twitch-info
plugins.description: twitchtitle / twitchuptime / twitchfollowers console commands for a configured channel, via the public decapi.me bridge (no OAuth needed).
plugins.author: homaaio

plugins.name: backup-config
plugins.description: "cfgbackup save|list|restore <name>" - timestamped backups of homrec.hrc before you go experimenting with settings.
plugins.author: homaaio
